title: Celebration of Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav, 75th Independence Day of India on 15th August, 2021 at Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission-Ghaziabad
bodyHtml:
Shri Mahendra Singh Tanwar (I.A.S.), Commissioner, Municipal Corparation, Ghaziabad and Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission hoisted the flag on 75th Independence Day

Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission-Ghaziabad celebrates the Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav, 75th Independence Day of India. It was attended by Shri Mahendra Singh Tanwar (I.A.S.), Commissioner, Municipal Corporation, Ghaziabad as Chief Guest, He was also accompanied by Shri Hari Krishna Gupta, Zonal Officer, Kavi Nagar, Municipal Corporation, Ghaziabad. Dr Raman Mohan Singh, Director Central Drug Testing Laboratory-Mumbai was also available to grace the occasion.

Dr Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director presented a Memento to Shri Mahendra Singh Tanwar (I.A.S.), Commissioner, Municipal Corporation, Ghaziabad.

Shri Mahendra Singh Tanwar, Commissioner, Municipal Corporation, Ghaziabad and Dr Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, placed a sapling in the campus on celebration of Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav, 75th Independence Day at Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission-Ghaziabad.
